preserve: Use the existing algorithm owner; preserve the public named exports and actual packaged consumer path.

baseline.scope: NO_PRIOR_OWNER applies only to the new forwarding/tool entry seam. The old implementation was already adapted and duplicated before this consolidation; no source-first claim is made for that old public file.
